formal_reason: R3 preregistration section 7 requires logical separation and states that a single assistant session cannot certify PASS.
No three genuinely separate blind GPT-family scorer sessions were established in the closing runtime.
Therefore the scorer-independence gate is not established even though within-session numerical replication is strong.

within_session_robustness_diagnostic.nature: strict / semantic-lenient / conservative rubric passes inside one GPT session; not independent scorers

p4_diagnostic.method: renderer isolation evidence plus high-specificity comparison against N+1 novel EpisodeArc fields; diagnostic only

scientific_interpretation.supported: A work-specific EpisodeSynopsisPlan supplies planning information that strongly improves deferred-policy adherence, debt handling, and target-state attainment relative to B and mismatched-plan N in the sealed renderings.
scientific_interpretation.not_yet_formally_proven: The preregistered causal-control PASS claim because true 3-scorer independence is not established.
scientific_interpretation.also_not_proven_by_CT13: That an autonomous planner can itself generate an equally good EpisodeSynopsisPlan from N-1 only.
